notes.title: Release Note V1.012
notes.content:
Hi resistances, 

V1.012 of Twelve Citys is out! Experience brand new miserable lives!

- More Supplies. 
More Titanium Alloy, more Laser Fusion module, more batteries. Less scavaging around!
More foods. Less hunger, less death!

- Three new Mission Threads.
Learn new skills from ICTS, and reveal the secrets of evolvement from clues of Cobra Shipment.

- Craft UI optimization.
Better crafting experience!

- More hints.
Less Confusion!

Thanks for the feedbacks, they helped us a lot!

notes.title: Release note V1.011
notes.content:
Hi resistances, patch 1.011 has been released.

- English language bug fixed. 
There're still some bugs, about 3~5 items as recorded thus far, we'll get it done in a patch later today. 

- Game tips.

- Lighthouse gameplay bug fixes.

- Some User Interface upgrade.
